item.title: DANP-Engine: Trusted AI Runtime
item.description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming industries and daily life, but its true potential can only be unlocked when trust is an inherent, foundational element. As AI systems become more autonomous and pervasive, ensuring their safety, reliability, and ethical operation is no longer optional—it is paramount. This report delves into the critical concept of a “Trusted AI Runtime,” which serves as the secure and verifiable operational core for AI models.
